⚔️ Conquest of Nine Kingdoms Offline Experience Event Is Coming!

Lords, are you ready to meet us in person?

This November, Conquest of Nine Kingdoms is teaming up with AppGallery to bring an offline player experience event to Selangor, Malaysia!

Whether you're a seasoned Lord or a newcomer to the Nine Kingdoms, you're welcome to join us for an exciting experience of real-time Three Kingdoms strategy battles, fun activities, and exclusive rewards!

📍 Event Location

Sunway Pyramid · Huawei Experience Store

Selangor, Malaysia

📅 Event Dates

November 28 (Sat) – November 29 (Sun), 2026

⏰ Event Time

12:00 PM – 6:00 PM

🔥 On-site Activities

1. Download the Game & Get a Lucky Draw Chance

Download Conquest of Nine Kingdoms on-site and get 1 lucky draw chance after verification by our staff! Already playing the game? Simply open the game on-site to participate as well.

2. Join the Official Community & Get a Gift

Join the official Conquest of Nine Kingdoms community and receive a special gift after on-site verification!

3. Experience the Game On-site

Try Conquest of Nine Kingdoms on Huawei devices available at the venue. Experience real-time command, free troop movement, and exciting battlefield battles. Complete the experience task to receive a gift!

4. Cosplay Photo Challenge

Take a photo with our on-site Cosplayers, share it on social media with the designated event hashtag, and get 1 additional lucky draw chance!

🎁 Exclusive On-site Rewards

Complete designated activities for a chance to receive:

1.Huawei Devices

2.Conquest of Nine Kingdoms In-game Gift Codes

3.Exclusive Official Merchandise

4.A3 Non-woven Bags

5.Game-themed Stickers

6.Custom Game Pins

7.Game-themed Hand Fans

8.Game-themed Water Bottles

🎉 Please Note: Physical gifts are available in limited quantities on a first-come, first-served basis, while stocks last! In-game gift codes will be distributed through an on-site lucky draw.

📢 Open to All Players!

Whether you're using a Huawei device or another Android device, everyone is welcome to join us!

Lords, we look forward to seeing you at Sunway Pyramid · Huawei Experience Store!

Command Freely. Win with Strategy.

🔥 S3 Alliance Rally｜Find Your Strongest Allies!

S3 "Han-Wei Clash" officially launches on November 28, and a new battle is about to begin!

Want to recruit more like-minded partners for your Alliance?

Want more Lords to see your Alliance?

Now is your chance to gather allies and grow your Alliance!

📅 Event Period

Nov 23, 2026 – Nov 30, 2026

⚔️ How to Participate

During the event, post your Alliance recruitment content directly in the comment section of this event post to join!

Your recruitment content must include at least:

• Alliance name

• Alliance intro / recruitment pitch

• Recruitment requirements

• Contact information or how to join the Alliance

You may add an original recruitment poster, Alliance screenshot, or other images to showcase your Alliance to more Lords!

🏆 Rewards

After the event, we will select 5 outstanding recruitment posts from all eligible entries in the comment section of this post and award the following in-game items!

🎁 Recruitment Tokens ×5 + Star Stone Chests ×10

📊 Judging Criteria

The official team will evaluate based on the following:

• Completeness of the recruitment content

• Creativity of the copy, poster, and content

• Engagement such as likes and replies

• Alliance identity and the appeal of the recruitment content

※ Engagement is only one reference factor; the number of likes is not the sole judging criterion.

📢 Notes

• Entries must be related to Conquest of Nine Kingdoms S3 Alliance recruitment.

• Each Alliance may receive the reward only once.

• Plagiarizing original content from other players or Alliances is prohibited.

• Any behavior that compromises event fairness, such as artificial inflation or fake engagement, will lead to disqualification.

• The winner list will be announced in an official post on our Facebook community after the event ends and review is completed.

📢 Important Notice | OBT Facebook Lucky Draw Winners, Please Contact Us!

Dear Lords,

We previously announced the winners of the Conquest of Nine Kingdoms OBT Facebook Lucky Draw.

However, some winners have not enabled private messages, which means our official team is currently unable to contact them directly.

Therefore, if you are an OBT winner who has not yet been in contact with our official team, please contact us within 7 days of this notice being published and provide the required information according to our staff's instructions so we can arrange your reward.

📩 How to Contact Us:

• Facebook: Send a private message to the official Conquest of Nine Kingdoms Facebook Page

• Discord: Contact our official staff member @Nelson

⏰ Please make sure to contact us within 7 days of this notice being published.

If a winner does not contact us within the specified period, they will be considered to have forfeited their eligibility for the reward, and the reward will no longer be reserved.

If you know any of the winners on the list, please help us spread the word and remind them to contact us as soon as possible!

🔒 Security Reminder:

Our official staff will never ask for your account password, verification code, or any form of payment. Please be cautious of unofficial messages and potential scams.

Congratulations again to all our winners, and thank you for your continued support of Conquest of Nine Kingdoms! ❤️

Conquest of Nine Kingdoms Operations Team
